content: Kapinga aramas pweipwei kin sohte konehng, e rasehng sinoh ni ahnsoun karakar de keteu ni ahnsoun dolung wahnsahpw.
Keria sohte kak kauweiukala ma sohte kahrepen en lelohng uhk. E rasehng menpihr me pipihrseli sohte kak sokedi.
Ke uhdahn pahn wokih oahs, salihedi ahs, oh ke uhdahn pahn wokih aramas pweipwei men.
Ma ke pahn sapeng peidek en sahliel ehu, ke pil sahliel duwehte aramas me wia peideko.
Wia pasapeng en aramas sahliel ong peidek en sahliel ehu, eri, me wia peideko pahn diarada me e sohte loalokong nin duwen me e kosekose.
Ma ke pahn ilakih aramas pweipwei men, eri, e konehng ke en lupukasang nehmwen; pwe met ke pekipeki ehu kahpwal.
Aramas pweipwei kak doadoahngki lepin mahsen audapan kan, duwehte aramas mwoator men me kak aluhki neh kan.
Kapinga aramas pweipwei men duwehte pirehiong takai ehu nan pahi.
Aramas pweipwei men me koasoia lepin mahsen audapan kan, kin katamanda aramas sakaula men me kin songosong en kihsang teken tuhke nan peh.
Koadoadoahki aramas pweipwei men sohte lipilipil me ke kasaingedi pahn kamadakihala aramas koaros me ieiang ih.
Pweipwei men me pwurehng wia eh tiahk en pweipwei, rasehng kidi men me kin pwurehng kangala eh mwus.
Aramas pweipwei douluhl mwahusang aramas me kin lemeleme me e loalokong, ahpw soh.
Dahme aramas pohnkahke men sohte kin pedohikihsang nan imwe? Dahme e masak? Laion kan?
Duwen aramas pohnkahke men eh kin koakoahnek nan dewe, ih pil duwen wenihmw ehu eh kin weliwelikek ni insis kan.
Ekei aramas me nohn pohnkahke, re pil sohte kak pein kihong mwenge nan ewerail.
Aramas pohnkahke kin lemeleme me e loalokong sang aramas isimen me kak kasalehda kahrepe mwahu en arail pepehm kan.
Iang pidada pingiping ehu me sohte ahmwohng, rasehng omw kekeid nan ahl apwoat oh poarehng salengen kidi kommwad emen.
Aramas emen me pitihedi emen ahpw uhd nda me e kamwakamwan, rasehng ohl sahliel men me mwadomwadongki dipwisou keper me kak kemehla aramas.
Ma sohte tuwi, kisiniei pahn kunla; ma sohte liketihti, akamai pahn tokedi.
Mwoalus kin kahrehiong tuwi eh kin wie ngkingken, tuwi kin kahrehiong kisiniei eh kin lullul, oh sounkaping wasa kan kin kamwakamwakid pingiping kan.
Liketihti me iou! Ia uwen atail kin men kang!
Lokaiahn aramas me kin karirihala dahme uhdahn mehlel en nan kapehde, rasehng melengileng en sah pwehl ehu.
Aramas liksansalamwahu kin karirihkihla lokaia kansenamwahu kailok en nan kepehde.
Ngihl pwukat pahn kaselel, ahpw ke dehr dukiong, pwe nan kapehde diren kailok.
E kak karirihala eh kailok, ahpw aramas koaros pahn kilang soahng suwed kan me e kin wia.
Aramas me kin wiahiong meteikan lidip, kin pein lohdiong loale. Aramas me kin tapihada ehngk en pwehl kin pein ohkihla ehngko.
Ke uhdahn pahn kailongkihla emen oh men kauwehkihla koasoi likamw. Lokaia likamw kin kahrehda paisuwed laud.
